briefHtml:
NAV S$10,278,439 — reported -0.24% (approx -0.03% real vs restated Monday base). Biggest mover: Xiaomi -5.55% Monday, round-tripping most of Friday's +9.7% pop, while the memory rout spread (MU -3.9%, Samsung -4%) on CXMT's new denser memory-cell design. One thing: Cleveland Fed's Hammack said policy is "not restrictive enough" two days before Wednesday's US CPI, while Houthis hit Riyadh airport again and Brent climbed back toward ~$106.

State

  • NAV S$10,278,439; reported -0.237%; listed sleeve -1.323%. navHistory restated: Oct 12 now 10,281,438 (FX outage print corrected). NAV level authoritative.
  • FX restored: USD/SGD 1.2807, CNY/SGD 0.191383 (USDCNY ~6.688), HKD/SGD 0.163205, MYR/SGD 0.31382.
  • priceErrors: L46.SI Yahoo 404 — 23rd consecutive session.

Flag integrity

  • riskFlags: 1 critical — "SMIC -8.3% in a day" (1.0% NW). Stale as a day move: actual Monday close HK$56.20, -2.5%. But SMIC is 39.6% below its 52-wk high; UBS upgraded to Buy (TP 96.20) Oct 9, Goldman Buy (TP 153) Oct 12.

Position moves (Mon Oct 12)

  • SGX rebound: STI 5,415.48 +0.25%, banks led bounce after last week's ~4% rout.
  • HK mixed: HSI +0.3% to 24,271; Tencent 425.80 +0.24% (USD + offshore-yuan bond plans); Xiaomi 24.52 -5.55%; SMIC 56.20 -2.5%.
  • US (Columbus Day, bonds closed): SPX 7,807 -0.05%; Dow ~51,850-51,867 +0.4%; Nasdaq -0.4%; VIX 15.21 +2.49%; UST 10y unchanged 5.24% (cash closed); DXY 102.58 +0.3%.
  • Memory rout leg 2: MU -3.88%, Samsung -4% in Korea on CXMT denser-cell progress, server memory targeted by end-2026. Energy top sector +1.49%.
  • Metals: silver held ~$60-61.3; gold ~$4,165-4,177, -0.5 to -0.7%. Oil: WTI/Brent +1.4%, Brent ~$106.

Insider (7d)

  • Wing Tai (W05.SI) Oct 6: Change in Interests of Director + Grant of Share Awards remain latest. None found for other held SGX/HK names. US holdings are ETFs — n/a.

Congress (Oct 8-13)

  • New Oct 8 filings: House Dem NJ-5 sold AMAT and MCD ($1-15K each); House Republican broad rebalance (sold SPCX, GS, C, MSFT, META lot, CSCO x3, MRK et al; bought SNOW, META, OKTA, GLW x2, CVX); PA Senate Dem 2x Dell bond buys (filed Oct 7).

Policy watch

  • Fed hawkish into CPI: Hammack — further tightening needed, "not restrictive enough". US CPI Wednesday (~3.6-3.7% headline cons.); Warsh at IMF Friday; bank earnings Tue; FOMC Oct 27-28.
  • Gulf: Houthis hit Riyadh airport again + Fujairah threatened; UK + 25+ countries attribute RAF Fairford incident to Iran. Russia struck 6 Ukrainian energy sites despite ceasefire claim; Merz rejects diesel deal.
  • China cuts NEV VAT export rebate 13% to 9% from Apr 2027 — mild back-loaded negative for Xiaomi EV exports.
  • Oil plumbing: OPEC +400k bpd demand growth; Saudi pipeline capacity 2-3 yrs to 10M bpd; Qatar cut Nov OSPs; Kazakhstan reportedly selling gold. India Sep CPI hot at 5.54%.

Risk

  • SMIC flag stale (actual -2.5%) but level story real: -39.6% from 52-wk high.
  • CPI-Wednesday binary into hawkish Fed + Brent ~$106 — the same oil-inflation-hike chain that derated SG banks last week.
  • Silver line: 1,777 oz at ~$60.4 ~ S$137.5k collateral vs S$56,240 loan; equity ~S$81.2k ~ 1.69x. A -4% silver day ~ -6.8% equity.
  • FX: ~35% of NW non-SGD; USD/SGD 1.2807 steady. Cash ~62% of liquid book. L46.SI unpriced (23rd session).

Alpha (signals, not advice)

  • Memory-cycle crack = Xiaomi BOM-relief thesis: Samsung -4%, MU -3.9% on CXMT. Signal: Xiaomi holding ~HK$24 while memory falls = accumulation zone.
  • SMIC reset: UBS/Goldman Buy upgrades landed INTO the slide. Signal: stabilization above ~HK$55 = re-entry trigger for Asia semis leg.
  • Energy/security sleeve stays bid (Brent ~$106, Gulf escalation). Duration gate CLOSED — 10y 5.24% into CPI; need under 5.20% to arm rally-and-hold.

trumpWatch.title: Fed hawkish drumbeat into Wednesday CPI
trumpWatch.detail: Cleveland Fed Hammack (2026 voter): further tightening needed, inflation returning to target too slowly, policy "not restrictive enough", prefers smaller frequent hikes; warns higher rates may not dissuade hyperscalers. US CPI Wed (cons ~3.6-3.7% headline); Fed Chair Warsh speaks at IMF early Friday; bank earnings Tue (JPM/GS/C/WFC); PPI Thu; FOMC Oct 27-28.

trumpWatch.title: Gulf escalation: Houthis hit Riyadh airport again; Fujairah threatened
trumpWatch.detail: Houthis targeted Riyadh airport + Khamis Mushait air base with drones Mon; warned US of "swift and painful response"; told Saudi oil-facility workers to stay away. Anti-ship ballistic missiles launched from Yazd toward Fujairah. Iran: Hormuz security will not return while US blockade continues. UK + 25+ countries attribute RAF Fairford incident to Iran; UK PM Burnham open to Saudi support requests.

trumpWatch.title: Russia struck 6 Ukrainian energy facilities despite Trump ceasefire claim
trumpWatch.detail: Zelensky offered to halt strikes on Russian energy + hold elections if Putin agrees 60-day ceasefire; Kremlin noncommittal. Novak confirmed diesel-supply talks; Germany's Merz: diesel deal "out of the question", sanctions must be tightened. NATO deputy commander: alliance must adopt tougher deterrence.

trumpWatch.title: China cuts NEV VAT export rebate to 9% from 13% (Apr 1, 2027)
trumpWatch.detail: Direct read-across to Xiaomi EV export economics — mild negative, back-loaded to FY2027.

trumpWatch.title: Oil plumbing: OPEC sees 400k bpd demand growth; Saudi pipeline 2-3 yrs to 10M bpd
trumpWatch.detail: Aramco exploring alternative export routes + overseas storage; Qatar slashed Nov OSPs (Marine at Oman/Dubai -$8/bbl). Kazakhstan reportedly selling gold as UST yields rise. Brent back toward ~$106 Mon (+1.4%).

trumpWatch.title: Europe/India: French budget debate Tue; ECB Stournaras gradual hikes; India CPI hot
trumpWatch.detail: EUR/USD -0.4% into French budget; BoE Mann flags wage-price drift; India Sep CPI 5.54% vs 5.4% expected (prev 4.82%).
